i.norm: Verifies that QCodec decodes an RFC 1522 Q-encoded word correctly. The input "=?UTF-8?Q?=3Drcy4cI]MK] ]-?=" follows the encoded-word format: =?<charset>?Q?<encoded-text>?= The quoted-printable escape "=3D" decodes to "=" (ASCII 0x3D), so the full decoded result is "=rcy4cI]MK] ]-".
Input: RFC 1522 Q-encoded word using UTF-8 charset; "=3D" is QP-escape for "="
